patch_description: The best-performing prior generation (score 0.89, lowest test loss/gap) used a modular layer structure with skip-2, skip-3 and diameter entangling layers. The current program regressed to a simpler, less effective topology (single skip-2 layer + distance-4 CRX) and dropped the skip-3 layer entirely, hurting both convergence speed and generalization (0.87 score, convergence_step jumped to 540). This edit restores the modular skip-2/skip-3/diameter architecture from the best generation, and additionally implements the recommended improvement: splitting each skip-2 and skip-3 entangling layer into two alternating shared parameters (even/odd indexed edges) rather than a single shared parameter per layer. This mirrors the proven alternating-strength pattern already used successfully in the nearest-neighbor ring layer, giving the mid-range entanglers slightly more expressive freedom (two knobs instead of one) while still keeping parameter count low via sharing. The expectation is tighter long-range mixing, reduced train-test gap, and faster convergence, consistent with the ring layer's alternating design that has repeatedly performed well.
